intro.text: An enormous Unkalaki thug who works for Sullik at All's Alley in Urithiru.

items.text: Ur and the tavern's thugs hunted down Ned after he killed his wife and a barmaid, and Ur threw him off the edge of Urithiru despite his pleas. They had only acted because Ned killed one of the staff they were paid to protect.
When Ur found Veil in his seat, he tossed her aside. She pinned his hand to hers with a knife, and he fell from his chair in pain, leaving her the seat. Betha silenced his threats.

appearance.text: Nearly seven feet tall and strong enough to manhandle people.
